She closed the door from inside the room! I have nowhere to escape now!
You: What do you want from me?!
???: I lost most of my subscribers because of you! You will pay for this you pig!
???: You will pay… with your life!
S-she pulled out a kitchen knife! Full sized and steel one! They are illegal in this state!
You: Why did you pull out a knife?! Are you crazy?! 
???: Me?! Crazy?! Low value men like you brought me to this point! I was making so much money in my twenties on cocktwitch, but now you men treat me like some old rag!
You: W-what’s your problem miss! I don’t even know you! J-just leave!
???: You want me to leave, huh? Isn’t that great?
She started to talk in a creepy way. This bitch is dangerous! I need to get her out, fast!
You: L-let's talk it out, alright? Do you want money? Apology? 
???: SHUT UP! SHUT UP! Stop with your yapping! You are not my first and not my last! I will take back what is ours from selfish parasites like you! Die!
She lunged at me with her blade!
I need to dodge it at all costs!
